people.name: Achaia
people.line: A Roman province in southern Greece, including Corinth.

people.name: Asia
people.line: A Roman province in western Asia Minor.

people.name: Epaenetus
people.line: A believer in Asia and beloved by Paul.

people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Greet the assembly that is in their house. Greet Epaenetus, my beloved, who is the first fruits of Achaia to Christ.
translations.bsb: Greet also the church that meets at their house. Greet my beloved Epenetus, who was the first convert to Christ in the province of Asia.
translations.kjv: Likewise greet the church that is in their house. Salute my wellbeloved Epaenetus, who is the firstfruits of Achaia unto Christ.
translations.asv: and salute the church that is in their house. Salute Epaenetus my beloved, who is the first-fruits of Asia unto Christ.
